The input is one integer `n`, where `0 <= n <= 10^6`. Print how many primes are less than `n`, so `n` itself doesn't count even when it is prime. With `n` this large, testing every number on its own by trying divisors is slow, so look for a way to rule out many numbers at once.

Input:

```text

```

Expected output:

```text

```
